title: Impact of Mirabegron on Erectile Function in BPH Patients
brief_summary: Evaluation of impact of Mirabegron on erectile function for patients treated for BPH
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All males above age 50 with LUTS due to BPH not candidate for prostatectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* males below age 50
* neurologic abnormality
* Any indication for prostatectomy
* abnormal bladder contractility i.e diabetics
study_population: All males above age of 50 with LUTS due to BPH
condition: Males With Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Symptoms
